summary: Materialise NV filed a Form 6-K (foreign-private-issuer current report, US equivalent of a press-release 8-K exhibit) disclosing weekly progress of its share buyback program announced 30 October 2025, under a discretionary mandate to an independent intermediary for up to EUR 30 million. In the 26–30 October 2026 window it repurchased 184,068 shares at an average EUR 6.47, totaling EUR 1,191,668, all via the central order book and NASDAQ; cumulative buybacks since 26 January 2026 reach 1,967,094 shares for EUR 11,331,390, or 3.3% of shares outstanding. Watch pace toward the EUR 30 million cap and any EPS or liquidity effect.
